title: Joint Client Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Optimal Federated Learning over Wireless Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning often relies on partial client participation because full participation is costly in cross-device wireless systems with limited uplink resources, heterogeneous channel conditions, energy constraints, and strict upload deadlines. However, partial participation introduces sampling variance, causing the sampled update to deviate from the full-participation update. Existing optimal client sampling methods reduce this variance but usually rely on simplified client-count budgets, while wireless-aware scheduling methods account for communication constraints but do not directly optimize sampling variance. This paper proposes resource-aware optimal client sampling (RAOCS), a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints. translated_title: 面向无线网络最优联邦学习的联合客户端调度与资源分配
translated_abstract: 联邦学习通常依赖于部分客户端参与，因为在上行链路资源有限、信道条件异构、存在能量约束且上传截止时间严格的跨设备无线系统中，让所有客户端全部参与的代价十分高昂。然而，部分参与会引入采样方差，导致采样得到的更新偏离全参与时的更新。现有的最优客户端采样方法能够降低这种方差，但通常依赖于简化的客户端数量预算；而面向无线特性的调度方法虽然考虑了通信约束，却并未直接优化采样方差。本文提出了资源感知的最优客户端采样（RAOCS），这是一个在上行资源块、轮次截止时间、更新信息和能量等约束下的统一方差最小化客户端调度框架。所得问题存在一个封顶注水式的解，该解在客户端更新重要性、无线资源约束等方面取得平衡……
tldr: 本文提出资源感知最优客户端采样（RAOCS）框架，在上行资源块、轮次截止时间、更新信息和能量等约束下联合优化客户端调度与资源分配，通过封顶注水解最小化部分参与带来的采样方差，实现无线网络中的最优联邦学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RAOCS, a unified variance-minimizing client scheduling framework that jointly optimizes client scheduling and resource allocation under uplink resource-block, round deadline, update-information, and energy constraints via a capped water-filling solution, enabling optimal federated learning over wireless networks.
